scope: CEO-owned task proposal drafts and attributable CEO decisions

invariants.ownership: Derive ownership solely from the validated CEO session; identifiers are not credentials.
invariants.source_message: A proposal source_message_id must identify a CEO-authored message in the caller-owned conversation.
invariants.proposal_state: Draft only; proposal contents do not authorize any action.
invariants.decision_immutability: At most one decision may be recorded for a proposal; replacement or editing requires a separate future governance design.
invariants.decision_expiry: Reject decisions with an expiry at or before the server evaluation time; record both decision time and expiry.
invariants.decision_scope: Persist the proposal project and required authority as the decision scope; do not accept a caller-selected scope.
invariants.separate_authority_gate: An approved decision has authority_effect none and must not create an assignment, execution, mutation, queue, provider request, or external action. Assignment and execution remain disabled pending separately authorized routes and gates.

activation_gates: Validated CEO session and owner binding
Selected persistent store with encryption, retention, backup, and restore controls
Approved idempotency, rate-limit, and cursor policy values
Immutable evidence-reference authorization in the selected project read model
Security and recovery acceptance proving no decision causes assignment or execution
